lever: Iron supplements, when a doctor confirms iron deficiency
intervention: Oral iron supplements in people with iron deficiency
summary: In people with iron deficiency, iron supplements reliably raise ferritin and haemoglobin. The right product, dose and length of treatment depend on the cause, so this is something to decide with a doctor.
whyThisGrade: Shown in people who are iron deficient, not in people with normal iron
caution: Low iron can have causes, such as blood loss, that need checking. Too much iron is harmful, and stomach side effects are common.
